listings.name: Dhammaloka Buddhist Centre
listings.blurb: The Buddhist Society of WA's city centre, fifteen minutes north of the CBD, running free guided meditation several times a week alongside Friday dhamma talks and WA's largest Buddhist library. The four-week introduction course starts on the first Saturday of each month, and newcomers are expected rather than merely tolerated.
listings._source: bswa.org/practices/guided-meditation-classes — address, class times and course format confirmed

listings.name: Beyond Rest East Perth
listings.blurb: Float tanks on Edward Street, backed by infrared sauna, red-light and contrast therapy. An hour in the dark and the salt is the quietest sixty minutes available in the inner city, and the intro three-pack brings a float under sixty dollars while you decide whether it's your thing.
listings._source: beyondrest.com.au/location-perth — address, phone, email, hours and intro pricing confirmed

listings.name: The Yoga Space
listings.blurb: Running since 2005 under founders with research doctorates and a thoughtful, non-performative approach, this Colin Street studio teaches Ashtanga, Vinyasa, Yin and pregnancy yoga in person and online. The three-week unlimited introduction is a proper way to test whether a regular practice fits your week.
listings._source: yogaspace.com.au plus directory listings — address, styles, founders and intro offer confirmed; casual class price not published, so priceFrom left null

listings.name: Unearth Remedy
listings.address: Sessions at Spanda Yoga, Fremantle WA 6160
listings.blurb: Monthly two-hour conscious connected breathwork in a warm room at Spanda Yoga, capped at ten people. Sessions pair the guided breathing with plain-science education and a follow-up email the next day, which is more aftercare than most group breathwork offers. Mats, bolsters and blankets provided.
listings._source: unearthremedy.org/breathwork — venue, price, group cap and contact details confirmed

listings.name: Sound Healing Perth
listings.address: Sessions at Surfing WA, Trigg; also Fremantle and Victoria Park
listings.blurb: Weekly crystal-bowl sound journeys at three venues across the metro — Trigg by the beach midweek and Sunday, with Fremantle and Victoria Park sessions on Sundays. Casual drop-ins run $44 and a three-session intro pack takes the edge off deciding. A guided meditation opens each session before the bowls take over.
